summary.name: react-desktop
summary.one_liner: A JavaScript/React component library that brings macOS Sierra and Windows 10 style native desktop UI elements to web apps.
use_cases: Giving a web app a macOS-style appearance
summary.what_it_does:
react-desktop is a JavaScript library built on top of Facebook's React. It provides components modeled on macOS Sierra and Windows 10 to give web-based projects a native desktop feel. The page says it works with NW.js and Electron.js and can be used in any JavaScript-powered project. The documentation is organized into sections for getting started, macOS components, Windows 10 components, contributing, and a change log.</what_it_does>
